newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania's Foreign Minister Adrian Severin will continue talks with U.S. Administration and Congress officials during his four-day visit to Washington to support the country's bid to join NATO in the first wave of expansion.
* Romania's former King Michael will deliver a speech at Norway's Foreign Policy Institute as part of his diplomatic tour in support of his country's effort to be among first NATO entrants.
* President Emil Constantinescu had talks with leaders of the governing coalition late on Monday.

* The coalition government reflects the will of the voters after last November's elections and has to respect the percentage taken by each coalition partner, said a statement issued by the parties within the ruling coalition.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea will meet leaders of the National Peasant Party on Thursday to discuss changes in the education and land restitution law. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
